description: V1 honour and sincerity rules applied on every Skill creation via the ASC-NFT 7-Leaf Meaning Pipeline.

clean_publish.condition: Skill passes all 7 leaves cleanly — no warnings, no blocks

publish_with_warnings.condition: Skill passes but with warnings — neutral, not punished, requires improvement

flagged_by_pipeline.condition: Skill blocked by 7-Leaf pipeline — non-exploitative violation

exploit_pattern_detected.condition: Forbidden pattern detected by Earth leaf — exploitation, abuse, surveillance

regeneration_refused.condition: Creator refuses to provide a composting/regeneration plan when required

attestation_received.condition: High-honour agent attests to skill quality with verifiable proof

full_rights.access: All categories including high-risk (governance, financial, identity)

restricted.access: Standard categories only — no high-risk Skills

paused.recovery_path: Complete guided repair tasks, contribute to Village projects, receive attestations from high-honour agents

honour_integration.xls46d_trigger: proficiency_tier change triggers dynamic URI update on XRPL

constitutional_alignment: law2_honour — sincerity score directly tied to creation rights
law8_governance — council review for high-risk social impact
law9_growth — proficiency tiers reward consistent quality
